AF-MS21083.name: AIRFASCO manufacturer MS21083 product index

D-MS21083.name: DLA ASSIST record: MS21083

BILD-MS35206.name: BILD Industries manufacturer MS35206/MS35207 reference
BILD-MS35206.scope: Selected MS35206 nominal thread/length mappings only; manufacturer table visually reviewed. Historical finish references not represented as current process requirements. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS24693-H.name: MS24693 revision H primary government drawing, manufacturer mirror

AF-MS24693.name: AIRFASCO MS24693 manufacturer index
AF-MS24693.scope: Supplemental cross-check of 100-degree head and C/S finish notation. Nominal dimensions use primary drawing rather than reproducing full catalog rows. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

CH-MS20605.name: Cherry CR9116 manufacturer standard page
CH-MS20605.scope: Revision AA, May 14, 2015: 100-degree flush head, selected -3 diameter grip codes 03 and 04. NASM20605 relationship appears in note 5; no blanket Cherry-part interchangeability asserted. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

CH-NAS1399.name: Cherry manufacturer A and AB family guidance
CH-NAS1399.scope: NAS1399 A versus AB wiredraw/locked-spindle family and tooling distinction; preserve full codes. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

CH-CR4172.name: Cherry CR4172 manufacturer standard page
CH-CR4172.scope: Revision P, January 20, 2021: selected B/AB aluminum configuration, -4 nominal diameter and grip 02 limits including note 4 minimum. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

CH-CR4622.name: Cherry CR4622 manufacturer standard page
CH-CR4622.scope: Revision AH, June 11, 2024: selected C/AB A286 configuration, -5 nominal diameter and grip 02 limits including note 4 minimum. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

CH-CR2672.name: Cherry CR2672 manufacturer standard page
CH-CR2672.scope: Revision AB, October 14, 2015: selected C/A A286 configuration, -5 nominal diameter and grip 04 limits. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

D-MS20605.name: DLA ASSIST MS20605 document record
D-MS20605.scope: Official indexed record: canceled August 18, 1998; successor NASM20605. Full direct record retrieval unavailable during review. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS35338-L.name: MS35338 revision L government drawing, supplier mirror
MS35338-L.scope: Primary drawing visually reviewed: selected nominal sizes and material groups. Plated carbon steel does not alone specify cadmium versus permitted zinc. Dash 96 is phosphor bronze/tin-brass, not steel. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

NAS620-8.name: NAS620 revision 8 standard, distributor-hosted authorized scan
NAS620-8.scope: Table I and material codes visually reviewed. Selected nominal thickness, screw-size reference and material only. Light-series suffix L retained. Manufacturer-summary thickness errors not carried into data. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

AN3-AN20-DRAWING.name: AN3 through AN20 revision 12 government drawing, AIRFASCO mirror
AN3-AN20-DRAWING.scope: Four-sheet primary drawing visually reviewed for selected AN3 and AN4 nominal length and grip. Family-specific grip values used; generic AN4 index incorrectly repeats AN3 grip values. Includes legacy drilling identifiers and no-dash convention. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

AF-AN3.name: AIRFASCO AN3 manufacturer reference
AF-AN3.scope: Supplemental manufacturer thread/drilling nomenclature cross-check for selected AN3 entries. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

AF-AN4-25.name: AIRFASCO AN4-25A manufacturer detail
AF-AN4-25.scope: Confirms 1/4-28 UNF-3A, 2.656 length and 2.188 grip. Manufacturer detailed page agrees with primary drawing; its generic AN4 index does not. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS21076-H.name: MS21076 revision H government drawing, technical-library mirror
MS21076-H.scope: Two-sheet primary drawing visually reviewed. Selected L08N: .1640-32 UNJC-3B; A286, passivated and dry-film lubricated, without eyelets. L is not the H silver-plated configuration. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

D-MS21076.name: DLA ASSIST MS21076 document record
D-MS21076.scope: Canceled February 7, 2000, successor NASM21076; direct record reviewed. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

NF-NAS1791.name: NAFCO NAS1791 family engineering reference
NF-NAS1791.scope: Family construction only: two-lug floating variable-counterbore nutplate with replaceable element. NAFCO proprietary NA2361 size/finish decoding is not transferred to NAS stock part numbers. No exact NAS thread, coating, counterbore depth or temperature rating asserted. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

AIA-NAS1791.name: AIA NAS1791 publisher catalog
AIA-NAS1791.scope: Confirms NAS1791 title and scope; no purchased drawing contents implied. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS51957-D.name: MS51957 revision D primary government drawing, supplier mirror
MS51957-D.scope: April 25, 1997. Table I selected thread/nominal length mappings and finish-code requirements reviewed, including B black oxide and -124 6-32 x 1-1/8. No current-revision claim. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS16995-H.name: MS16995 revision H primary government drawing, supplier mirror
MS16995-H.scope: April 25, 1997. Table I selected thread/nominal length mappings and B finish code visually reviewed. UNC-3A; selected -51 and -52 are 1/4-20, not #8. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS16996-F.name: MS16996 revision F primary government drawing, distributor mirror
MS16996-F.scope: November 24, 1993. Two-sheet scan visually reviewed: -2 0-80 x 3/16; -10, -12, -14 are 10-32 x 1/2, 3/4, 1. UNF-3A; unsuffixed selected parts passivated. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MW-MS16996-2.name: MW Components / Ideal Fasteners MS16996-2 manufacturer detail
MW-MS16996-2.scope: Supplemental primary manufacturer cross-check for 0-80 UNF-3A and passivated stainless. Manufacturer displays a length range; selected table uses nominal 3/16 from drawing rather than confusing the minimum with nominal. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

NAS1352-11.name: NAS1352 revision 11 primary standard, distributor-hosted scan
NAS1352-11.scope: 2009 revision 11 five-sheet standard plus notice; tables and code pages visually reviewed. Selected UNRC-3A threads; lengths in 1/16 increments, including additional intermediate and shorter lengths permitted by code paragraph. C is CRES, N heat-resistant steel; default selected finishes passivated; LB patch type. No wholesale transfer from MS16995 size numbers. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

AN960-21.name: AN960 revision 21 primary government drawing, AIRFASCO mirror
AN960-21.scope: Three-sheet drawing visually reviewed for selected nominal screw sizes, thicknesses, material and L light-series notation. Aluminum D6L/D10L .032 nominal; selected C2L .016. No automatic cross-standard part conversion asserted. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

NAS1149-4.name: NAS1149 revision 4 primary standard, distributor-hosted copy
NAS1149-4.scope: February 2008. Table I and II visually reviewed. N416/N432 refer to #4; 0432/0463 refer to 1/4; 0332/0363 refer to #10; 0516 refers to 5/16. D aluminum, F carbon steel, C CRES; J chemical treatment, K anodize, H none, P cadmium, R passivate. User-added hyphens normalized only; all significant zeroes retained. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

D-MS16996.name: DLA ASSIST MS16996 document record
D-MS16996.scope: Official indexed record: canceled June 30, 1998; named successor NASM16996. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

BILD-MS16555.name: BILD MS16555 manufacturer table
BILD-MS16555.scope: Selected 601,602,618,620,625,626,627,629 nominal dimensions and passivated CRES group. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

RM-DOWELS-3.name: Richard Manno manufacturer dowel listing, page 3
RM-DOWELS-3.scope: Selected nominal size cross-checks; manufacturer stock levels and certifications are not transferred to Webson. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

RM-DOWELS-4.name: Richard Manno manufacturer dowel listing, page 4
RM-DOWELS-4.scope: Selected 631 1/8 x 1 and CRES configuration cross-check. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

RM-DOWELS-5.name: Richard Manno manufacturer dowel listing, page 5
RM-DOWELS-5.scope: Selected 640 3/16 x 5/8, 643 3/16 x 1 nominal dimensions. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

BILD-MS16562.name: BILD MS16562 manufacturer size table
BILD-MS16562.scope: Seven selected CRES slotted-pin diameter/length mappings. Nominal pin size is distinct from free-state diameter and mating-hole limits. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

NASM16562-1998.name: NASM16562 initial-release primary standard, supplier mirror
NASM16562-1998.scope: October 1998 two-page drawing visually checked for selected slotted-pin mappings and material/finish. No latest-revision claim. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS20426-L.name: MS20426 revision L primary government drawing, supplier mirror
MS20426-L.scope: Five-page drawing, September 14, 1994; material and finish notes visually reviewed. A material=1100, AD=2117; terminal A=clear anodize. Diameter in 1/32, length in 1/16, countersunk length includes head. Decimal stock notation -5.5 retained without asserting canonical standard PIN or length. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS20470-K.name: MS20470 revision K primary government drawing, supplier mirror
MS20470-K.scope: Five-page scan visually checked: universal head, AD material, A clear anodize versus unsuffixed chemical treatment, nominal diameter/length coding. Under-head length convention. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS21209-F.name: MS21209 revision F primary government drawing, technical-library mirror
MS21209-F.scope: Eight-page primary drawing visually checked: tanged screw-locking CRES; installed nominal length multiple; selected 04/06/C6/F1 threads; L dry film and P cadmium coating. C510 cannot safely distinguish missing-zero C0510 versus missing-separator C5-10, so thread and length are deliberately not decoded. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

KATO-PARTS.name: KATO manufacturer insert numbering and thread table
KATO-PARTS.scope: Selected NAS1130 thread, nominal length multiple and locking/free-running mappings only. No public approved-alternate list or proprietary-equivalent claims. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

KATO-NAS1130-FINISH.name: KATO tangless dry-film strip-feed manufacturer reference
KATO-NAS1130-FINISH.scope: Confirms 06 thread/1D dry-film strip-feed association and explicitly distinguishes strip-feed packaging from standard NAS designation. Stock DSF string retained as supplier ordering identifier. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

BOLLHOFF-INSERTS.name: Bollhoff Aerospace Buyers Directory, issue 3 August 2012
BOLLHOFF-INSERTS.scope: NAS1130 page 54: tangless free-running and screw-locking, P cadmium and D dry-film versus self finish. No current issue or named brand of Webson stock asserted. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS51959-D.name: MS51959 revision D government drawing, supplier-hosted copy
MS51959-D.scope: April 25, 1997, four sheets visually reviewed. Table I confirms selected -1 through -5 and -12 through -17 thread/length mappings; 82-degree head; UNC-2A. Unsuffixed selected parts are passivated 300-series CRES. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS15795-G.name: MS15795 revision G government drawing, supplier-hosted copy
MS15795-G.scope: July 10, 1986, eight sheets visually reviewed. Selected 803,805,806,807,808,810,812,813 are the 300-series CRES group. Nominal ID, OD and thickness from Table I, not measured limits. B black-oxide finish; unsuffixed selected parts passivated. Manufacturer BILD table has misleading column labels; government drawing controls this reference. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS51848-E.name: MS51848 revision E government drawing, supplier-hosted copy
MS51848-E.scope: December 13, 1993, two sheets visually reviewed. Table II specifically maps NAS1676C0/C2/C4 to MS51848-41/-43/-45; Table I identifies #0/#2/#4 and CRES group. Used for selected nominal size and material identification only. NAS1676 dimensions and tolerances are not copied from the replacement standard. No blanket substitution claim. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

NAS1676-ADOPT.name: NAS1676 government adoption notice, supplier-hosted copy
NAS1676-ADOPT.scope: Primary government notice identifies lock-spring, helical, hi-collar construction. Adoption dated September 29, 1995. This is an adoption notice, not the full NAS standard. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS16535-J.name: MS16535 revision J government drawing, archival copy
MS16535-J.scope: May 26, 1992, all three sheets visually reviewed. Selected -3: carbon steel, body .058–.061, nominal length 5/32; -66N: nickel-plated brass, body .085–.089, length 3/16; -77: aluminum, body .085–.089, length 5/32. Table I material columns and length rows checked. N nickel finish preserved. Aluminum finish not asserted because the drawing permits options. No current-issue or stock-lot certification claim. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

MS16633-D-A1.name: MS16633 revision D amendment 1 government drawing, archival copy
MS16633-D-A1.scope: November 13, 2014, Table I, requirements and Table III visually reviewed. -1014: .140 shaft reference, .025 basic T, cadmium-plated carbon spring steel. -4006/.4009/-4018: .062/.094/.188 shaft references, .010/.015/.025 basic T, passivated CRES. T is an unplated basic dimension; drawing note adds .002 to the maximum thickness tolerance for plated and CRES rings. No load capacity or current-revision claim. Manufacturer web pages contain generic carbon-steel load-calculation notes even on CRES numbers; government part table controls the material description. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-NAS662-NEF.name: North East Fasteners official NAS662 product references
FINAL-NAS662-NEF.scope: Manufacturer indexed product documentation confirms 2-56 UNC-2A, 100-degree cross-recessed head, 300-series CRES, passivated, patch-type locking and 3/16 length. Individual C2R2/R4/R5/R9 pages checked in indexed manufacturer documentation: 1/8,1/4,5/16,9/16. Direct fetch unavailable; indexed official manufacturer descriptions used. C2R3 length corroborated by BILD manufacturer table. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-NAS662-BILD.name: BILD Industries NAS662 manufacturer table
FINAL-NAS662-BILD.scope: Selected C2R2 through C2R5 mappings: 2-56, lengths .125,.188,.250,.312. Passivated 300-series CRES. Manufacturer table, not full NAS standard. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-NAS662-C0.name: Hardware Specialty own-brand NAS662C0LPR3 catalog documentation
FINAL-NAS662-C0.scope: Own-brand primary product documentation names NAS662C0LER3/NAS662C0LPR3, 0-80 UNF-2A, 3/16 length, 100-degree Phillips head, passivated stainless and nylon patch. Exact Webson stock LP identifier retained; no public interchangeability claim from vendor slash designation. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-NAS8100-FD.name: Fastener Dimensions manufacturer NAS8100–NAS8106 series document
FINAL-NAS8100-FD.scope: Manufacturer primary documentation confirms A286, .1120-40/.1380-32 threads, full thread, cross recess NAS7100. U clean/passivated; hyphen cadmium Type II Class 2 with green end marking. No locking code in selected stock; U is a finish code, not a locking code. No latest-revision claim. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-NAS8100-SIZES.name: Hardware Specialty own-brand NAS8100U8 catalog documentation
FINAL-NAS8100-SIZES.scope: Primary own-brand official catalog: 4-40 UNJC-3A x 1/2, A286, no locking element. NAS8100U6 (1249792) 3/8; NAS8100U12 (1249781) 3/4; NAS8101U8 (1249799) 6-32 UNJC-3A x 1/2. Manufacturer Fastener Dimensions controls finish descriptions over vendor generic Plain label. U6/U12 lengths also match owner workbook descriptions. NAS8100-6 uses same length code as U6; original-stock dash and finish retained. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS21044-H.name: MS21044 revision H government drawing, Airfasco manufacturer mirror
FINAL-MS21044-H.scope: September 21, 1993, three sheets visually reviewed. Selected sizes 04=4-40,06=6-32,3=10-32,4=1/4-28; UNJC/UNJF-3B. Regular height, nonmetallic insert. C passivated CRES; N cadmium-plated steel. No current-issue claim. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS21042-H.name: MS21042 revision M government drawing, supplier mirror
FINAL-MS21042-H.scope: January 6, 1995, two sheets visually reviewed. Selected -4=1/4-28 UNJF-3B, L3=10-32 UNJF-3B. Non-CRES steel, cadmium plated; L dry-film lubricant. Reduced-height/reduced-hex all-metal locknut. Existing guide sections retained. Reviewed 2026-10-22. Revision M confirmed from the scan; legacy source key retained.

FINAL-MS21075-H.name: MS21075 revision H government drawing, Airfasco manufacturer mirror
FINAL-MS21075-H.scope: March 28, 1995, two sheets visually reviewed. Selected 06=6-32 UNJC-3B,08=8-32 UNJC-3B,3=10-32 UNJF-3B. L dry film; hyphen non-dry-film. N no eyelets. Reduced rivet spacing, low height, floating, two lug, steel. Plating optional for L under manufacturer reference; no blanket cadmium assertion for L entries. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS21075-AIR.name: Airfasco manufacturer MS21075 code index
FINAL-MS21075-AIR.scope: Official manufacturer code documentation: N without eyelets; L dry-film lubricant. Non-dry-film selected versions cadmium plated; dry-film plating type optional. Thread references cross-checked with government drawing. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS21077-NAFCO.name: NAFCO manufacturer NASM21077 family documentation
FINAL-MS21077-NAFCO.scope: Primary manufacturer technical documentation and both October 27, 2022 revision E NA2369 drawing sheets reviewed. Floating two-lug, nonmetallic nylon insert, steel nut. Size 8-32 UNJC-3B. No named manufacturer of Webson stock or full MS-to-NA2369 part conversion asserted. Public selected stock row identifies legacy MS21077-08 exactly; retainer-specific coating not inferred. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS27183-D.name: MS27183 revision D government drawing, supplier mirror
FINAL-MS27183-D.scope: June 17, 1991, three sheets visually reviewed. -3 #4, ID .125–.135 OD .312–.327 T .028–.048; -5 #8, ID .187–.197 OD .437–.452 T .036–.065. Carbon steel. Cadmium/zinc options exist; no specific stock-lot coating asserted. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS35333-K.name: MS35333 revision K government drawing, archival mirror
FINAL-MS35333-K.scope: December 13, 1993, two sheets visually reviewed. Selected -36 #4, -38 #8, internal tooth, carbon steel. Public nominal dimensions use BILD manufacturer reference and are explicitly labeled nominal; no coating assumed for stock lots. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS35333-BILD.name: BILD Industries internal-tooth washer manufacturer reference
FINAL-MS35333-BILD.scope: Selected internal -36 #4 nominal ID .119 OD .263 T .017; -38 #8 nominal ID .172 OD .333 T .021. Do not apply the internal dash sequence or material group to external MS35335 entries. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

FINAL-MS35335-G.name: MS35335 revision G government drawing, supplier mirror
FINAL-MS35335-G.scope: February 2, 2004, three sheets reviewed. -57 #4, ID .115–.123 OD .245–.260 thickness .015–.019; -59 #8, ID .168–.176 OD .365–.381 thickness .018–.023. Both are passivated corrosion-resistant steel UNS S41000, not cadmium-plated carbon steel. Public table uses limits, not nominal midpoints. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

OCT27-MS21044-H.name: MS21044H government drawing, manufacturer-hosted scan
OCT27-MS21044-H.scope: Sheet 1 Table I, revision H September 21, 1993. Selected A height and B across-flats min/max, including locking deformation. Visually checked October 27, 2026.

terms: AN hardware
Army-Navy standards identify many aircraft hardware families. Each series has its own requirements and revision history.
MS hardware
Military Standard designations appear on drawings and purchase orders. Some remain active; others have moved to NASM or another standard.
NAS and NASM
NAS means National Aerospace Standards. NASM includes military-origin standards adopted into that system.
Series and dash number
A series identifies the hardware family. A dash number selects an item within that family; its meaning must be checked in the specific standard.
UNC and UNF
Unified coarse and fine thread series. Diameter, pitch and thread class must all match the specified requirement.
CRES
Corrosion-resistant steel. The term alone does not identify every material or processing requirement for a part.
Specification revision
The issue of a standard required by the drawing, purchase order or contract. Include an explicit revision requirement when one applies.
Document supersession
A standard has been replaced by another document. This relationship alone does not approve a complete part-number substitution.
Certificate of conformance
A declaration that the supplied product meets the identified requirements. Include required certificate details with the RFQ.
Lot traceability
Records connecting supplied hardware to its manufacturing or material lot as required by the order.
